title: Roll20 Handout Review Completion Rate
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:session handout_type=* reviewed_before_session=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(reviewed_before_session="yes",1,0))) as matched by handout_type
| eval pre_session_review_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - pre_session_review_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Roll20 handouts that end with pre-session review by handout type.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which handout type are helping or hurting Roll20 handouts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `pre-session review` on `rpg:session` events and summarize the hit rate by `handout_type`.
visualization: Table of handout type with percentage of Roll20 handouts ending with pre-session review.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often pre-session review happens for each handout type so you can see where Roll20 handouts go smoothly or get stuck.
